Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto

Class LendingHistoryFilterDto

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto.LendingHistoryFilterDto
public class LendingHistoryFilterDto extends Object
Data Transfer Object for filtering lending history. Used to specify criteria for filtering lending records when viewing lending history.
